content: Benchmark repos document result-affecting bug fixes via explicit versioning: lm-evaluation-harness (official new_task_guide.md) requires bumping a task 'version' field on breaking changes plus a dated changelog entry with PR number, e.g. 'Version 0.0 -> 1.0: Fixed a bug with answer extraction that led to underestimated performance'; result-affecting fixes ship grouped in versioned releases with a Task Fixes section (v0.4.13 release notes verified via gh api). Canonical industry cases of numbers changing after fixes/reboots: HF Open LLM Leaderboard v1-to-v2 reboot declared results non-comparable; SWE-bench Verified re-annotation changed rankings; EvalPlus HumanEval+ added tests dropping scores (cases from synthesis, not primary-verified).
